decision: Keep every v0.16 runtime file unchanged. Publish reproducible experiments and regression guards; none of the four optimization candidates is selected.

reasons.a: Final complete skill-action medians improve 3.5–5.4%, but full-equipment rebuild medians regress 1.6–2.5%. The one-ring result also does not consistently improve.
reasons.b: Derived typed-array storage introduced a larger full-equipment cost in its first measured comparison.
reasons.c: An inherited array-index setter is invoked during attributes(), unlike the retained implementation; rejected on semantics regardless of timing.
reasons.d: Safe array construction preserves the setter contract, but a confirmation run does not reproduce initial performance gains.

measurementLimits: Small timing changes include environmental/JIT/GC variation; unchanged tree-preview code also varies between controls.
A current release run compares identical runtime code and cannot establish an optimization.
Development-runner CPU sampling is a diagnostic target, not attribution of the regression or a release-renderer result.
No allocation-volume, Steam Deck, older-mobile, full-native or whole-frame claim.
